subtitle: TTMIK · 2026-09-14
description: Fourteen dating words along one arc: someone introduces you, nothing has a name yet, somebody finally says it.

spine.title: 노선도 · 연애의 순서
spine.note: Korean names each stage; English blurs them: 만남 (Someone introduces you), 썸 (No label yet), 고백 (Someone says it), 연애 (Counting from day one), 이별 (It ends).
spine.caption: 만남 → 썸 → 고백 → 연애 → 이별. The middle one is the word English has no equivalent for.

explain.title: 한눈에 · The big picture
explain.why: Korean has a word for each stage of dating. English blurs them together.

tiles.en: A friend sets up a blind date
Liking each other, no label yet
Day 100 together is a big day

cards.alt: Two coffees on a cafe table with a pink heart
cards.en: My friend goes on a lot of blind dates these days.

cards.ko: 회사 선배가 소개해 준 사람이랑 데이트를 했어요.
cards.en: I went on a date with someone a senior at work introduced to me.

cards.alt: A phone with chat bubbles and a half-filled heart
cards.ko: 두 사람은 아직 사귀지 않지만 썸을 타고 있어요.
cards.en: The two of them aren't dating yet, but they're in the talking stage.

cards.alt: A cute smiling face with hearts and a sparkle
cards.ko: 애교가 많은 사람도 있고 없는 사람도 있어요.
cards.en: Some people have a lot of aegyo and some don't.

cards.alt: A love letter sealed with a heart, with sweat drops
cards.ko: 고백하고 싶은데 너무 떨려서 말을 못 했어요.
cards.en: I wanted to confess, but I was so nervous that I couldn't say it.

cards.ko: 어제 고백을 받아서 오늘부터 사귀기로 했어요.
cards.en: I received a confession yesterday, so we decided to start dating today.

cards.alt: A gift box with a tag that says 100
cards.ko: 다음 주가 백 일이라서 선물을 준비하고 있어요.
cards.en: Next week is our hundredth day, so I'm preparing a present.
We were together a long time, but in the end we broke up.

qa.title: 예상 질문 · Questions

items.a: 사귀기 전에 서로 좋아하는 것 같은 단계예요. 영어로는 딱 맞는 말이 없어요.
items.aen: It's the stage before dating where you both seem to like each other. There is no exact English word.

items.qen: How are gobaek and sagwida different?
items.a: 고백은 마음을 말하는 순간이고, 사귀다는 그다음부터 시작하는 관계예요.
items.aen: Gobaek is the moment you say how you feel; sagwida is the relationship that starts after it.

items.qen: Why do Koreans celebrate the 100th day?
items.a: 처음 만난 날부터 날짜를 세기 때문에 백 일이 중요한 날이 돼요.
items.aen: Because the days are counted from the first day you met, so day 100 becomes a real milestone.

items.qen: How do you say aegyo in English?
items.a: 딱 맞는 단어가 없어서 보통 그냥 애교라고 해요. 귀엽게 행동하는 거예요.
items.aen: There is no exact word, so people usually just say aegyo. It means acting cute.

items.a: 보통 친구나 회사 선배가 두 사람을 소개해 줘요.
items.aen: Usually a friend or a senior at work introduces the two people.

items.a: 밀고 당기기예요. 관심 있는 것처럼 하다가 조금 멀어지는 거예요.
items.aen: It is "push and pull": acting interested, then pulling back a little.

qa.note: The questions a Korean friend would actually ask back. Answer in your head, then tap to compare.

items.en: a blind date set up by a friend
to be in the talking stage
push and pull, playing hard to get
to date, to go out with

full.title: 그림 카드 · The sentences
full.ko: 요즘 친구가 소개팅을 많이 해요. 회사 선배가 소개해 준 사람이랑 데이트를 했어요. 두 사람은 아직 사귀지 않지만 썸을 타고 있어요. 애교가 많은 사람도 있고 없는 사람도 있어요. 고백하고 싶은데 너무 떨려서 말을 못 했어요. 어제 고백을 받아서 오늘부터 사귀기로 했어요. 다음 주가 백 일이라서 선물을 준비하고 있어요. 오래 만났지만 결국 헤어졌어요.
full.en: My friend goes on a lot of blind dates these days. I went on a date with someone a senior at work introduced to me. The two of them aren't dating yet, but they're in the talking stage. Some people have a lot of aegyo and some don't. I wanted to confess, but I was so nervous that I couldn't say it. I received a confession yesterday, so we decided to start dating today. Next week is our hundredth day, so I'm preparing a present. We were together a long time, but in the end we broke up.

station_en: Words for each stage of dating: 소개팅, 썸, 고백, 백일.
